Oh look everyone, it's the master of mastering the art of meaningless titles! Syed "Full-Stack Delusion" Hussain, the research assistant who's researching how to stretch a bachelor's degree into a decade of underachievement. Let's take a moment to admire his impressive journey from low-level "Development Chair" at the esteemed IEEE CIS MJCET to... well, not much else, really. This walking résumé buzzword bingo card has racked up more skills than an overachiever in a quarantine coding bootcamp, yet his professional portfolio is as empty as his future prospects. With a stunning lack of key contributions or accomplishments, it's no wonder his academic pedigree is the only thing keeping his dream of renaissance coder alive. But don't worry, I'm sure that Masters from Lil' Techy will eventually pay off - perhaps he can be the virtual greeter for Illinois Tech's MemorializedInDebt Metaverse!
